name: @mizchi/cloudflare-starterkit-mbt
description: Starter kit for Cloudflare Workers in MoonBit with D1 + sqlc + Pulumi + CI/CD

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-int64-binds.mjs --verify && node scripts/check-sql-placeholder-mix.mjs && moon build --target js --release && node scripts/prepare-worker.mjs && node scripts/check-worker-bundle.mjs dist/app-core.js
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
